items.stem:
Karthik wrote this program to compute take-home pay:
bonus = 44
def display(salary, rate=6):
    global bonus
    tax = salary * rate // 100
    bonus = bonus + 5
    return salary - tax + bonus

print(display(6000))
print(display(6000, 7))
print(bonus)
(i) Name one local and one global variable in the program. (1)
(ii) Which parameter is a default parameter? (1)
(iii) Write the output of the program. (2)
items.answer: (i) Local: tax (or salary, rate); global: bonus (ii) rate (iii) 5689 / 5634 / 54
items.markingKey: 1 + 1 + 2 marks (½ mark per correct output line, 2 marks for all three).

items.stem:
Consider the function:
def convert(r, q, x=5):
    return r + q * x
Which of the following function calls is valid?
items.answer: convert(q=4, r=1)
items.markingKey: (a) convert(q=4, r=1) is valid. A call must give values for r and q exactly once and cannot put a positional argument after a keyword argument.
